summary: Add rate limiting to the auth API and surface it in the login UI.

steps.title: Add token-bucket rate limiter middleware
steps.description: Implement a per-IP token bucket and wire it into the auth router.
steps.rationale: Blocking brute-force login attempts was a must-have for both users.

steps.title: Return 429 with retry-after from auth endpoints
steps.description: When the limiter trips, respond 429 and include Retry-After.
steps.rationale: Agreed compromise: user A wanted a hard block, user B wanted a retry hint.

steps.title: Show rate-limit banner in login form
steps.description: Display a banner when the API returns 429.
steps.rationale: User B's requirement; independent of the backend change.

resolutions.outcome: compromise: 429 + Retry-After instead of a silent hard block
resolutions.rationale: Satisfies both must-haves without over-blocking legitimate retries.
